name: pm51-powerup
summary: PM51 deep-standby wake: settle time after the power-good poll 50 ms instead of 100 ms (GP27U / M27P20P: 50 ms)

edits.asm: power state machine wake power-up: mov r7,#0x64 -> mov r7,#0x32 (delay in ms after the reg 0x9C poll)

notes: Addresses are PM51 code addresses (package offset 0x10080 + addr). The 5 ms wait at 0x4078 and the power-good poll are unchanged. Generated by tools/patches_src_pm51_powerup.py (SETTLE_MS=50-100).
